sections.title: Gender agreement
sections.content: Many adjectives ending in -o change to -a when they describe a feminine person or noun: alto → alta, simpático → simpática. Adjectives such as joven and amable do not change for gender.

items.spanish: Carlos es joven. Ana es joven.
items.english: Carlos is young. Ana is young.

sections.content: The adjective agrees with the person or noun it describes, not with the speaker. For further reference, see Lingolia's Spanish adjective agreement reference.
